methodologyAndLimits: All 163 ranking-table entries on PDF pages 12-13 independently parsed; five wrapped country labels resolved from adjacent lines. All 160 app scores/ranks/movement values compared.

Categories checked against coloured dots for all rows and the five-colour legend in rendered PDF pages 12–13: ranks 1–8 Very High, 9–66 High, 67–124 Medium, 125–149 Low, 150–163 Very Low. All 160 app categories agree.
Palestine, Kosovo and Taiwan omitted by app; publisher ranks preserved. Exclusion of Palestine differs from other app indices that include permanent observers.
2026 publication year is not a common observation date for every underlying indicator.
